title: Prescription Insurance on File: Prior Authorization Requests, Decision Due Dates, Approvals and Renewals
content:
**Prescription Insurance on File** — rules for prior authorization with the plan and the prescriber.

## 1. Starting a request

A claim rejected prior authorization required starts a prior authorization request the same day, through the class's submission channel. A prescription has at most one open request per coverage record: a new request is started only when no earlier request for the same prescription and coverage is still waiting for a decision.

## 2. Review speed and decision due date

The request is expedited only when the prescriber attests that waiting could seriously jeopardize the patient's health; otherwise it is standard. Its decision due date is the submission date plus the class's standard decision hours, or plus the expedited decision hours when expedited, counted in elapsed hours from the submission and rounded up to the calendar date on which the last hour falls.

*Hypothetical:* a standard request submitted at 10:00 on 2 May under a class with a 72-hour standard clock runs to 10:00 on 5 May, so its decision due date is 5 May. An expedited request submitted at 15:30 on 2 May under a 24-hour clock runs to 15:30 on 3 May, so its decision due date is 3 May.

## 3. Emergency supply while waiting

While a request is waiting, a plan whose class emergency supply days are above 0 pays one emergency supply of up to that many days, on the emergency prior-authorization supply basis. A class showing 0 pays none.

## 4. Approval

An approval covers claims for that prescription on that coverage from its approval date to its approval end date, which is the approval date plus the class's default approval months unless the plan states another date. Claims under it carry the approval's reference and the approved-prior-authorization basis.

*Hypothetical:* approved on 10 January under a class with 12 default months and no other date stated by the plan, the approval ends 10 January of the following year.

## 5. Renewal

A renewal request is started no earlier than the class's renewal lead days before the approval end date. *Hypothetical:* with an approval ending 30 June and a 30-day lead, a renewal may be started on 31 May or later, not on 30 May.

## 6. Denial

The clause "A denial ends the request; the patient may then pay cash, use a discount program where allowed, or appeal under the appeal rules" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for what follows a denial.

## 7. What the desk says

Kestrel never tells a patient that a request will be approved.
